name: abnormal-mcp
description: The full Abnormal Security REST API as an agent-ready CLI — with a local threat store, ranked SOC triage, and one-shot reporting no SOAR pack offers.

abnormal_api_token.title: ABNORMAL_API_TOKEN
abnormal_api_token.description: Sets ABNORMAL_API_TOKEN for the Abnormal Security MCP server. Get a credential from the Abnormal Security portal under Settings, Integrations, Abnormal REST API.

abnormal_base_url.title: Abnormal Security API base URL
abnormal_base_url.description: Base URL for the Abnormal Security API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

abnormal_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
abnormal_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

abnormal_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
abnormal_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API instead of the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

abnormal_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
abnormal_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Abnormal Security requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

abnormal_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
abnormal_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
